articles.title_en: Raising taxes on passive income could bring Russia’s budget an additional 700 billion rubles a year, economist says
articles.lead_en: Applying Russia’s progressive personal income tax to income from deposits, dividends, investments, and property sales could bring the budget roughly 500–700 billion rubles in additional revenue a year, economist Dmitry Polevoy estimated.
